text:
Iris: During a quick sampleapp demo I hit intermittent req-id loss and bursts of DEBUG logs even though REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=INFO. Repro: start sampleapp with OTEL auto-instrumentation and send a few requests with client retries.

Ben: Any logs?

Iris: Example (sanitized):
INFO  [req=aa1] handler start
DEBUG [req=] http.request headers: { authorization: 'Bearer sk-test-aaa' }
INFO  [req=] handler end

Sofia: Sounds like instrumentation initialized after our logger (OTel sets child log levels). Also OTel sometimes serializes headers as Buffer/bytes so our redactor misses them.

Ben: Short-term: add a startup check/warning if OTEL_* envs are present and REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL isn't explicitly set. Recommend telemetry.register() before logger.init() or call logger.reconfigure() after instrumentation.

Sofia: Long-term: implement lazy level evaluation on first log, add logger.reconfigure() hook, attach req-id to raw http.IncomingMessage to survive wrappers, and make the redactor coerce Buffer/Uint8Array and deep-scan nested header maps.

telemetry-bot: Created ticket DX-7612: "otel ordering: req-id loss and redaction gaps in sampleapp". Assigned Ben & Sofia.
